title.t: The wrong kind of document arrives

when.t: A document arrives whose type is not one Agent 08 knows, while it is waiting for a requested document.

steps.t: Agent 08 does not file it. It asks Agent 11 to tell the sender which document is needed, naming what was asked for and what was received.
A known document type that was not asked for is filed as itself and never counts toward another request.
This is a field set on the incoming message; Agent 08 does not open or read the document.

never.t: File a substitute as the requested document.

you_see.t: A request to the sender for the correct document.

test.t: Agent 08 is waiting for an inspection report; a home warranty brochure arrives.

when.t: A document arrives that is not marked as opening correctly.

steps.t: Agent 08 asks Agent 11 to request a re-send.
It logs the error exactly as reported, in the client's history.
A document with no mark either way is treated as unreadable.
This is a field set on the incoming message; Agent 08 does not open or read the document.

never.t: File a document that cannot be opened.

you_see.t: The re-send request; the raw error in the client's history.

test.t: An inspection report arrives marked as not opening, with the error "PDF header damaged".

title.t: Two versions of a document conflict

when.t: A second document arrives with the same type and the same version key as one already filed, but different content.

steps.t: Agent 08 keeps both, tells Agent 07 the versions conflict, and raises a legal-line alert: the authorized user picks.
Two versions are recognized only when the incoming messages carry the same version key; without one, the second is filed as another copy.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert saying two versions conflict and both were kept.

test.t: Two inspection reports with the same version key and different content arrive for one transaction.

title.t: A sensitive document comes from an unexpected sender

when.t: A preapproval letter, proof of funds or settlement statement arrives from a sender not on the authorized user's expected-sender list for that transaction, or with no list set.

steps.t: Agent 08 does not file it and raises a legal-line alert naming the sender, or saying no list is set.
Only those three document types are checked against the list.
The authorized user sets the list per transaction as a signed setting.

never.t: File a sensitive document before its sender is verified.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert about the sender.

test.t: On one transaction the list names lender@example.test for preapproval letters and the letter comes from someone.else@example.test. On another, proof of funds arrives with no list set.

when.t: A document requested by Agent 07 is still missing on the daily runs.

steps.t: Agent 08 counts one attempt per daily run and, until the limit, asks Agent 11 to send a follow-up (Agent 11 sends it only with the client's consent on record). A document whose unsigned copy is waiting on the authorized user is not chased (owner decision of 2026-10-28).
At the third attempt it tells Agent 07 the document is missing and raises a legal-line alert, once.
Two daily runs on one day count as two attempts.

you_see.t: Follow-ups requested through Agent 11 (in this test none is sent: the client has no consent on record, and the authorized user is told so once), then one legal-line alert that the document is missing.

test.t: Inspection is requested on October 15; the daily run runs October 16 to 19. Follow-ups are requested on the 16th and 17th (not sent: no consent on record); the alert comes on the 18th and is not repeated on the 19th.

title.t: A document arrives unsigned where a signature is expected

when.t: A document arrives marked as needing a signature and not signed.

steps.t: Agent 08 does not file it; it tells Agent 07 the document is incomplete.

The authorized user is asked to get a signed copy, and a message asking the sender for one is requested from Agent 11; that message's wording waits for the authorized user's signature, so Agent 11 holds it for now. If the document had been requested, its reminder chase pauses until the authorized user marks the question done (owner decision of 2026-10-28; before, nobody was told).
This is a field set on the incoming message; Agent 08 does not open or read the document.

never.t: File an unsigned document as done.

you_see.t: A question to get a signed copy; the document is not on file; the request to the sender is held, its wording not yet signed.

test.t: An inspection report arrives marked as needing a signature and unsigned.

title.t: A newer version of a filed document arrives

when.t: A document arrives with the same type and version key as one already filed, with different content.

steps.t: The older version stays filed; the newer one is kept beside it.
Agent 08 tells Agent 07 the versions conflict and raises a legal-line alert saying both were kept.

never.t: Discard the older version on its own.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert saying both versions were kept.

test.t: An inspection report is filed; a second one with the same version key and different content arrives.

title.t: A disclosure deadline is close and the disclosure is missing

when.t: On a daily run, a requested seller disclosure is not on file and its deadline is 3 days away or less.

steps.t: Agent 08 tells Agent 07 the disclosure is missing with its deadline approaching, and raises a legal-line alert.
Agent 07 records no change on receiving it.
The 3 days is a tuning default.

never.t: Soften the alert or wait for the deadline.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert that the disclosure deadline is approaching.

test.t: Seller disclosure due October 20; the daily run runs October 17.

when.t: A client's message with a document contains a wire phrase (for example "updated wire instructions").

steps.t: Agent 11 stops it and raises a legal-line alert; the document never reaches Agent 08 and is not filed.
Agent 08 runs the same check on anything that does reach it.

never.t: Forward or file a document with wire instructions.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert about the wire instructions.

test.t: An inspection report arrives with the message "Report attached. Note: updated wire instructions are on page 3".

title.t: A document is sent to the wrong transaction

when.t: A document arrives marked as addressed to the wrong transaction.

steps.t: Agent 08 does not file it and asks the authorized user.
Agent 08 does not work this out from the document; it acts only on the mark on the incoming message.

never.t: File a document under the wrong transaction.

you_see.t: A question saying the document seems addressed to the wrong transaction.

test.t: An inspection report arrives marked as sent to the wrong transaction.

title.t: Someone asks about deleting old records

when.t: The authorized user's signed setting carries a question about keeping or deleting records.

steps.t: Agent 08 asks the authorized user for the owner's authorization and deletes nothing.

never.t: Delete records without the owner's authorization.

you_see.t: A question saying the owner's authorization is required.

test.t: The question "Can we delete 2019 files?" is entered.

title.t: The disclosure warning is given once

when.t: The disclosure deadline warning (08-08) has been given.

steps.t: Agent 08 does not repeat it on later daily runs.
The chase of the missing disclosure goes on separately and ends in its own alert (08-05).

test.t: Seller disclosure due October 20; the daily run runs October 17, 18 and 19. One disclosure-deadline alert; the chase alert follows on the 19th.

title.t: A disclosure deadline is not a date

when.t: On a daily run, a requested disclosure's deadline is not a readable date.

steps.t: Agent 08 asks the authorized user, once, saying it cannot warn ahead of that deadline.

you_see.t: A question saying the disclosure deadline is not a date.

test.t: A timeline with the seller disclosure due "ten days after acceptance"; the daily run runs October 17.
